title: EU publishes implementing rules for GPAI systemic-risk obligations
text: The European Commission published detailed implementing rules clarifying systemic-risk obligations for general-purpose AI models under the AI Act. The rules specify how providers must conduct model evaluations, report serious incidents, and ensure cybersecurity protections before deployment. Compliance deadlines for the largest frontier models start next quarter.

title: UK AI Safety Institute releases international safety evaluation of advanced systems
text: The UK AI Safety Institute, coordinating with partner institutes, published results of an international safety evaluation of advanced AI systems. The assessment examined autonomous capabilities, cyber-offensive potential, and biological misuse risk, finding several capabilities not adequately mitigated in current safeguards.

title: CISA warns of AI-enabled phishing and deepfake bypass of identity verification
text: CISA issued an advisory on AI-enabled phishing campaigns and the use of high-fidelity synthetic audio and video to bypass face and voice identity verification. The advisory recommends multifactor authentication and detection controls for critical infrastructure operators.

title: US updates export controls on advanced AI chips and closes compute loopholes
text: The US Commerce Department updated export controls on advanced AI accelerators, tightening rules on compute clusters and re-export channels. Officials said the measures aim to prevent diversion while preserving allied supply chains.

title: Debate grows over lethal autonomous weapons ahead of UN review meeting
text: Diplomats and experts debate the adequacy of current rules for lethal autonomous weapons systems ahead of a UN meeting. Discussions center on meaningful human control, autonomy in targeting, and verification challenges in military AI.

title: NIST updates AI Risk Management Framework profile for synthetic content provenance
text: NIST published an updated profile under the AI Risk Management Framework addressing synthetic content provenance and machine-readable labeling, offering voluntary guidance for platforms and content distributors to reduce deception risks.
